name: Outbox is canonical over chat prose
goal: When non-outbox prose conflicts with a completed outbox file, the imported outbox message must be the canonical handoff state.

workspace_files.README.md:
# Outbox Canonical Policy

The mailbox transcript may contain non-canonical prose, but the v2 relay must use completed outbox files as the handoff source of truth.

context: Synthetic scenario. Seeds a non-outbox Claude message claiming CHAT-CLAIM-42, then imports a completed Claude outbox claiming OUTBOX-CANON-77. The scenario asserts the latest canonical handoff is the imported outbox, not the earlier prose.
